spans.s:
m. (-णुः)
1 An atom, a minute and elementary particle of matter.
2 A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum, Rox.)
m. or mfn. (-णुः-ण्वी-णु)
1 Atomic, small, minute.
E.
अण to sound, and उ Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Skilful, clever.
2 Small, minute.
E.
अणु small, and कन् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
The state or being of an atom, also अणता.

f. (-भा)
Lightning.
E.
अणु minute, and भा light.

f. (-णुः)
Small particles of dust, a dust of atoms.
E.
अण, and रेणु dust.

n. (-लं)
The moats in a sunbeam.
E.
अणुरेणु, and जाल assemblage.
